responsibility: Implements GCC’s generic pretty-printer used by diagnostics and other textual emitters. It owns buffered formatted output, GCC-specific % formatting codes, quoting and identifier translation, prefixing and line-wrapping rules, URL escape emission, multibyte-aware character handling, and Windows console escape-sequence translation, producing the formatted text that higher-level diagnostic code decorates with locations and source excerpts.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for GCC's pretty-printer: it provides the actual buffered formatting, wrapping, quoting, URL emission, multibyte handling, and Windows escape-sequence support behind the pretty_printer API declared in pretty-print.h.
